name: pagefeather-site-manager
description: Pagefeather: make WordPress sites in your own Cloudflare account, from a page that looks like WordPress admin.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Your email address. Only you can open the site manager: Cloudflare checks this email when you sign in.

PAGEFEATHER_KEY.description: A key that lets the site manager make sites in your account. [Create the key in Cloudflare](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/api-tokens&permissionGroupKeys=%5B%7B%22key%22%3A%22workers_scripts%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22edit%22%7D%2C%7B%22key%22%3A%22workers_kv_storage%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22edit%22%7D%2C%7B%22key%22%3A%22workers_r2%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22edit%22%7D%2C%7B%22key%22%3A%22account_settings%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22read%22%7D%5D&name=Pagefeather%20site%20manager). The page is filled in for you. Select **Continue to summary**, then **Create Token**. Copy the key and paste it here. Cloudflare shows it only once.

BUNDLES.description: Storage for the WordPress files. Keep the name as it is.
